model_choice: Direct binary formulation with helper coverage indicators. ~30 candidates + ~150 valid blocks = ~180 variables. Fits easily within 1,500 variable threshold for CGA GPU annealer. Uses linear constraints for cardinality and coverage implication. Invalid blocks are removed in data generation to ensure every block has a variable.

blocks.meaning: Street block (only those not already covered by existing playgrounds)

k.meaning: Number of new playgrounds to select

prep.notes:
Filtered existing playgrounds and blocks to Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg district. 
Excluded blocks within 250m of existing playgrounds. 
Generated candidate locations by computing the centroid of blocks grouped by LOR code extracted from block keys (digits 5-8), 
as LOR shapefiles were not provided. 
k=3 is fixed per specification.
